title: Ben's guide to e-girls — the playful cut

scenes.title: Ben has a question.
scenes.narration: Ben! What is an e girl? Excellent question! I'm Claudia. Welcome to your extremely unofficial internet field guide. And yes, this music suggests a cyberpunk uprising. We're mostly discussing eyeliner.

scenes.title: Internet style. Human underneath.
scenes.narration: E girl means electronic girl. Usually, it's an alternative fashion style and online persona. Think makeup, outfits, and playful self expression. Very online! Still a person. No charging cable required.

scenes.title: A remix, not a uniform.
scenes.narration: Mix emo and goth fashion with anime, gaming, and internet creativity. TikTok helped put the look in the spotlight around twenty nineteen. Basically, an alternative fashion mood board discovered a ring light. And here we are!

scenes.title: The accessories department.
displayText: Cat ears: optional. Extra RAM: zero.
scenes.narration: Look for winged eyeliner, blush, tiny hearts, dyed hair, layered shirts, and chains. Cat ear headphones? Sometimes! Now, do those adorable ears give your computer extra memory? Oh, Ben. Tragically, zero. Just cute little ears, doing their best.

scenes.title: More than the outfit.
scenes.narration: It's the persona, too! Outfit videos, makeup, games, memes. Or just wearing a look you enjoy. Streaming is completely optional. No final boss. No makeup exam. Honestly, a very reasonable admissions policy.

scenes.title: Let people name their look.
displayText: Not every woman who plays games
scenes.narration: Quick note, Ben! This does not mean every woman who plays games. Some people love the label; others hear it as an insult. Let people name their own look. The outfit tells you very little about the person.
